Card Q&A.a: Yes. You're revealing cards from your deck, which means they’re public information until you choose one to place face down on top of your security stack. You must show the card you place in your security stack to your opponent first.
Card Q&A.q: When using this card’s effect to place a card on top of my security stack, do I need to show it to my opponent?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. Reveal as many cards from your deck as you can, then perform the rest of the effect as normal.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card if I have 1 or fewer cards left in my deck?

Effect: [Main] Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Place 1 of them on top of your security stack face down. Add the remaining card to your hand. Then, place this card in your battle area.
